3) Data pipeline (128→256)¶

In [23]:
# --- Cell: Data pipeline ---
HR_SIZE = 256
LR_SIZE = 128
BATCH   = 16

def read_pair(path: Path):
    bgr = cv.imread(str(path))                   # BGR uint8
    if bgr is None: raise FileNotFoundError(path)
    rgb = cv.cvtColor(bgr, cv.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    # center-crop to square to avoid distortion (optional but helps)
    h, w = rgb.shape[:2]
    side = min(h, w)
    y0 = (h - side) // 2; x0 = (w - side) // 2
    crop = rgb[y0:y0+side, x0:x0+side]

    hr = cv.resize(crop, (HR_SIZE, HR_SIZE), interpolation=cv.INTER_CUBIC).astype("float32")/255.0
    lr = cv.resize(crop, (LR_SIZE, LR_SIZE), interpolation=cv.INTER_AREA).astype("float32")/255.0
    return lr, hr

def pair_gen(files, batch=BATCH, shuffle=True):
    n = len(files)
    idx = np.arange(n)
    while True:
        if shuffle: np.random.shuffle(idx)
        for i in range(0, n, batch):
            batch_idx = idx[i:i+batch]
            lr_list, hr_list = [], []
            for j in batch_idx:
                lr, hr = read_pair(files[j])
                lr_list.append(lr); hr_list.append(hr)
            yield np.stack(lr_list, 0), np.stack(hr_list, 0)

# sanity check
x, y = next(pair_gen(train_files, batch=2, shuffle=False))
print("LR batch:", x.shape, "HR batch:", y.shape)  # (2,128,128,3) (2,256,256,3)

LR batch: (2, 128, 128, 3) HR batch: (2, 256, 256, 3)

4) U-Net 128→256 model¶

In [24]:
# --- Cell: UNet 128->256 (fixed metrics) ---
def conv_block(x, f, dr=0.05):
    x = Conv2D(f, 3, padding="same")(x); x = BatchNormalization()(x); x = Activation("relu")(x)
    x = Conv2D(f, 3, padding="same")(x); x = BatchNormalization()(x); x = Activation("relu")(x)
    x = Dropout(dr)(x)
    return x

def unet_128to256(dropout=0.05):
    inp = Input(shape=(LR_SIZE, LR_SIZE, 3), name="lr_128")

    # Encoder: 128 -> 64 -> 32 -> 16 -> 8
    c1 = conv_block(inp, 32, dropout);    p1 = MaxPooling2D(2)(c1)
    c2 = conv_block(p1,  64, dropout);    p2 = MaxPooling2D(2)(c2)
    c3 = conv_block(p2, 128, dropout);    p3 = MaxPooling2D(2)(c3)
    c4 = conv_block(p3, 256, dropout);    p4 = MaxPooling2D(2)(c4)

    # Bottleneck at 8x8
    bn = conv_block(p4, 512, dropout)

    # Decoder back to 128
    u6 = Conv2DTranspose(256, 3, strides=2, padding="same")(bn)
    u6 = concatenate([u6, c4]); u6 = conv_block(u6, 256, dropout)

    u7 = Conv2DTranspose(128, 3, strides=2, padding="same")(u6)
    u7 = concatenate([u7, c3]); u7 = conv_block(u7, 128, dropout)

    u8 = Conv2DTranspose(64, 3, strides=2, padding="same")(u7)
    u8 = concatenate([u8, c2]); u8 = conv_block(u8, 64, dropout)

    u9 = Conv2DTranspose(32, 3, strides=2, padding="same")(u8)
    u9 = concatenate([u9, c1]); u9 = conv_block(u9, 32, dropout)

    # Extra upsample to reach 256x256
    u10 = Conv2DTranspose(32, 3, strides=2, padding="same")(u9)
    u10 = Conv2D(32, 3, padding="same", activation="relu")(u10)

    out = Conv2D(3, 1, activation="sigmoid", name="sr_256")(u10)
    return Model(inp, out, name="UNet_128to256")

# Give metrics real names (no lambdas) so Keras registers them
def psnr(y_true, y_pred):
    return tf.image.psnr(y_true, y_pred, max_val=1.0)

def ssim(y_true, y_pred):
    return tf.image.ssim(y_true, y_pred, max_val=1.0)

model = unet_128to256(dropout=0.05)
model.compile(optimizer=Adam(1e-4), loss="mae", metrics=[psnr, ssim])

model.summary()

5) Time-budget + callbacks¶

In [25]:
# --- Cell: TimeBudget + callbacks ---
class TimeBudget(Callback):
    def __init__(self, minutes=60, ckpt_path="assignments/day12_real_time_object_detector/checkpoints/sr_budget.keras"):
        super().__init__()
        self.budget = minutes * 60.0
        self.start = None
        self.ckpt_path = ckpt_path
        Path(ckpt_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    def on_train_begin(self, logs=None):
        self.start = time.time()
    def on_batch_end(self, batch, logs=None):
        if time.time() - self.start >= self.budget:
            try:
                self.model.save(self.ckpt_path)
                print(f"\n[TimeBudget] Saved checkpoint: {self.ckpt_path}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"\n[TimeBudget] Save failed: {e}")
            print("[TimeBudget] Budget exceeded. Stopping.")
            self.model.stop_training = True

ckpt_best = "assignments/day12_real_time_object_detector/checkpoints/sr_best.keras"
callbacks = [
    EarlyStopping(monitor="val_loss", patience=3, min_delta=1e-4, restore_best_weights=True),
    ReduceLROnPlateau(monitor="val_loss", factor=0.5, patience=2, min_lr=1e-6, verbose=1),
    ModelCheckpoint(ckpt_best, monitor="val_loss", save_best_only=True),
    TimeBudget(minutes=60),
]

# --- Cell: Fit config & training ---
MAX_STEPS_PER_EPOCH = 1000   # cap to keep epochs bounded on CPU
MAX_VAL_STEPS       = 50

steps_per_epoch = min(len(train_files)//BATCH, MAX_STEPS_PER_EPOCH)
val_steps       = min(max(1, len(val_files)//BATCH), MAX_VAL_STEPS)

EPOCHS = 40  # we allow many; EarlyStopping/TimeBudget will cut it
print("steps_per_epoch:", steps_per_epoch, "| val_steps:", val_steps, "| epochs:", EPOCHS)

train_gen = pair_gen(train_files, batch=BATCH, shuffle=True)
val_gen   = pair_gen(val_files,   batch=BATCH, shuffle=False)

history = model.fit(
    train_gen,
    steps_per_epoch=steps_per_epoch,
    validation_data=val_gen,
    validation_steps=val_steps,
    epochs=EPOCHS,
    callbacks=callbacks,
    verbose=1
)

In [27]:
# --- Cell: Eval & visualize ---
def show_examples(n=4):
    samples = random.sample(val_files, k=min(n, len(val_files)))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(n, 4, figsize=(16, 4*n))
    if n == 1: axes = np.expand_dims(axes, 0)

    for i, p in enumerate(samples):
        lr, hr = read_pair(p)
        pred = model.predict(lr[None,...], verbose=0)[0]
        bic  = cv.resize((lr*255).astype(np.uint8), (HR_SIZE, HR_SIZE), interpolation=cv.INTER_CUBIC).astype(np.float32)/255.0

        psnr_pred = tf.image.psnr(hr, pred, 1.0).numpy()
        ssim_pred = tf.image.ssim(hr, pred, 1.0).numpy()
        psnr_bic  = tf.image.psnr(hr, bic , 1.0).numpy()
        ssim_bic  = tf.image.ssim(hr, bic , 1.0).numpy()

        for ax, im, title in zip(axes[i],
                                 [lr, bic, pred, hr],
                                 [f"LR 128x128",
                                  f"Bicubic\nPSNR {psnr_bic:.2f} SSIM {ssim_bic:.3f}",
                                  f"Prediction\nPSNR {psnr_pred:.2f} SSIM {ssim_pred:.3f}",
                                  "HR 256x256"]):
            ax.imshow(np.clip(im,0,1))
            ax.set_title(title); ax.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

show_examples(4)
